Terms & Conditions

Terms and Conditions

Draft for foundation review. This policy is not approved for public use.

01 / Terms & Conditions

Terms and Conditions

These terms describe the use of the website of Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation. Please read them alongside our Privacy Policy and, where relevant, our Donation and Refund Policy.

02 / Terms & Conditions

Purpose of the website

The website provides information about the foundation, its story, work and planned initiatives. It also allows visitors to submit enquiries about volunteering, partnerships and support. Program announcements describe the stage and details confirmed at the time of publication.

03 / Terms & Conditions

Using the website

Please use the website responsibly. Do not submit false information, impersonate another person, misuse forms, upload harmful content or attempt to interfere with the website or its records.

04 / Terms & Conditions

Information and program availability

We aim to keep website information clear and accurate. Historical activities, upcoming programs and planned initiatives are identified separately. Program dates, eligibility and availability will be announced when confirmed and may be updated.

Submitting an enquiry does not confirm enrolment, a volunteer role, a partnership or an agreed contribution arrangement.

05 / Terms & Conditions

Content and permissions

The foundation’s website text, identity and approved media should be used with respect for the rights of the foundation and the people represented. Contact us before reproducing photographs, videos, logos or substantial website content. Materials belonging to third parties remain subject to their permissions.

06 / Terms & Conditions

External websites

Links to social platforms, partners or service providers may take you to websites operated by others. Review their policies before submitting information or making use of their services.

07 / Terms & Conditions

Support and contributions

Contribution methods, purpose restrictions, receipt arrangements and applicable donation terms must be confirmed before a contribution is accepted. Tax benefits or foreign-contribution eligibility are not implied by an enquiry or by the presence of this website. Refer to the Donation and Refund Policy for the approved process.

08 / Terms & Conditions

Website availability

The website may be temporarily unavailable for maintenance or other reasons. Please use the approved contact channels if a form or website feature does not work.
